column3: With respect to the Courtyard Amarillo Downtown Mortgage Loan (2.1%), $2,475,000 was deposited into a reserve account for implementing a PIP, which includes (i) repainting and repairing exterior building finishes and sidewalks; (ii) implementing an updated decor package, (iii) updating lobby areas, elevators, public restrooms, the fitness center, the meeting room and boardroom, guestrooms, guest bathrooms, corridors and stairwells, the guest laundry, the administrative office area and the back of house kitchen and house laundry room; and (iv) updating and verifying compliance of fire protection and life safety systems. The PIP is required to be completed by October 20, 2027.
